BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-12 commit 88b88da. 21 content files + 7 ADRs. STAGE 15 done: 00o-new-covenant-what-changed.md.

DELIBERATE DECELERATION — did NOT race back to Matt 24:36. Governing question: when Scripture speaks of the New Covenant, what does it explicitly say changes, what continues, what is unresolved? STARTING DISCIPLINE: not Christianity, not Judaism, and NOT PAUL — 'new covenant' originates in the prophets, so start there; Paul enters late as a witness to interpret, not the lens.

MAJOR REFINEMENT (self-correction of this project's OWN phrase): 'one covenant story from Genesis to Revelation' SUPERSEDED by 'ONE COVENANTAL STORY CONTAINING MULTIPLE COVENANTS, CULMINATING IN MESSIAH.' Driver: Jer 31:32's explicit 'not like the covenant I made with their fathers' — Yahweh names the EXODUS covenant specifically. Abrahamic precedes Sinai; Davidic adds a dimension; New is promised. One story, NOT interchangeable covenants. Old phrasing invited the exact flattening Jeremiah forbids. Logged in 00a corrections table.

FINDINGS: Jer 31:31 recipients unchanged (house of Israel + house of Judah) — converges with Rom 11 / Eph 2 reached independently. Fault located on THE PEOPLE (Jer 31:32 'my covenant that they broke'; Heb 8:7-8 all three translations put faultfinding on them) — BRAKE: don't press into 'Sinai had no deficiency', Heb 7:11 attributes some insufficiency to the arrangement. Jer 31:33 Hebrew natatti et-torati beqirbam / ve'al-libam ekhtavennah = Torah INTERNALIZED not erased, locus external->internal. BRAKE: must NOT become a slogan pre-answering Sabbath/food/festivals — that's Category Collapse wearing a Jeremiah quotation.

CJB JEREMIAH 31 VERSIFICATION CONFIRMED: offset exactly ONE verse (CJB 31:33 = ESV 31:34), verified by direct lookup. First fetch attempt returned sun/moon/stars (ESV 31:35) which is how the offset surfaced — recorded so the error is reproducible.

EZEKIEL 36:27 — Ruach CAUSES obedience, doesn't replace it. All 3 translations keep the causal construction. ADDS A THIRD FUNCTION to this vault's own model of the Ruach: illuminates, guides, AND produces covenant faithfulness. Reached from the prophets, not from what 00b needed. Now in 00b section C.

EZEKIEL 37:11 — resurrection language joins the semantic family (with cosmic-collapse, cloud-coming, heaven-and-earth); Yahweh supplies His own referent 'these bones are the whole house of Israel'. BRAKE STATED IN SAME BREATH — this is the possibility MOST useful to preterism so it gets LESS rope: 1 Cor 15, Dan 12, John 5, Rev 20 each still argued on own evidence. Ezek 37:24 puts TORAH-KEEPING INSIDE the everlasting-covenant promise = direct prophetic support for 'internalized not erased'.

THREE PIECES OF CONTRARY EVIDENCE RECORDED HONESTLY:
1. EZEK 37:26-28 promises a sanctuary 'in their midst forevermore' TWICE. Real cost for any AD-70-Temple-passing reading. Four options tabled none selected. 2 Cor 6:16's apparent citation of Ezek 37:27 FLAGGED UNVERIFIED. Ezekiel 40-48 bookmarked, deliberately NOT opened (Daniel 2 discipline) — note it contains SIN OFFERINGS which any 'sacrifice finally ended' reading must address.
2. JER 31:34 'they shall ALL know me' / 'no longer shall each one teach' — not descriptive of any observed community; teaching continued, Hebrews is itself a teaching document. Hebrews 8 quotes it unqualified. Cost for any fully-consummated reading.
3. ZECHARIAH 6:13 DOWNGRADED to suggestive-only. ESV 'a priest ON his throne' (same figure) BUT CJB 'a cohen BEFORE his throne' and RVR1960 'sacerdote A SU LADO' both = SEPARATE figure; all three end 'counsel of peace between them BOTH'. 2 of 3 read a distinct priest. Priest-king case rests on Ps 110:4 + Heb 7 instead. Same discipline as CJB 'this people' at Stage 13.

CHRONOLOGICAL ANCHOR: Luke 22:20 / 1 Cor 11:25 tie the New Covenant to YESHUA'S DEATH — not AD 70, not Pentecost, not future. Noted as suggestive-not-proof: puts inauguration and old administration's disappearance ~40yr apart, matching Heb 8:13's transitional window (which stays at 'permits').

TABLE: 10 rows populated with evidence, 2 marked UNRESOLVED (sanctuary; 'all shall know'). Sabbath/food/festivals/circumcision not yet investigated.

NEW METHOD RULES in 00b:
- CATEGORY COLLAPSE TEST, SECOND FACE: imported categories. moral/civil/ceremonial is THEOLOGICAL TAXONOMY not biblical terminology. Not a refutation — a requirement to ARGUE for the split not assume it. Exposed by circumcision being an ABRAHAMIC sign predating Sinai (Gen 17:10-11). Both faces = same failure: not letting the text define its own units.
- ELEVEN-QUESTION PROTOCOL for a Torah command (origin/audience/purpose/prophetic anticipation/Yeshua/Acts/apostolic/retained?/transformed?/discontinued?/inferring beyond text?). Q8-10 deliberately NOT complements. The 7-step test is for PASSAGES; this is for COMMANDS.
- COMPANION QUESTION: PURPOSE. 'What changed?' unintelligible without 'what was it FOR?' Gal 3:24 paidagogos = guardian/custodian NOT schoolmaster (ESV/CJB/RVR1960 have all moved off it; popular English memory hasn't). Held against Rom 7:12 'the law is holy' from same author. ANY reading requiring one to erase the other is too crude IN EITHER DIRECTION.

CIRCUMCISION TEST CASE: 1 Cor 7:19 'neither circumcision nor uncircumcision counts, BUT KEEPING THE COMMANDMENTS OF GOD' — all 3 translations agree, no escape hatch. Open question 21: how is circumcision commanded in Torah while Paul distinguishes it from keeping God's commandments? Investigation not contradiction. Food DEFERRED on principle: Acts 10:28 shows Peter's own interpretation is about PEOPLE, so Acts 10 can't be wielded as 'pork is clean now' — BUT disproving that doesn't prove dietary law binds Gentiles (Anti-Replacement).

NEXT STAGE: SACRIFICE AND PRIESTHOOD — not Sabbath, not food. Reason is methodological: Scripture argues this case most fully. Chain = LEVITICUS 16 (Day of Atonement) -> PSALM 110 -> YESHUA -> HEBREWS 7-10. Hypothesis to TEST not assume: 'Yeshua doesn't merely cancel the sacrificial pattern; He is the reality the pattern pointed to.' If it holds, project finally has a WORKED EXAMPLE of what pleroo looks like instead of a dictionary argument. HARD SEQUENCING CONSTRAINT: read Leviticus 16 BEFORE Hebrews' interpretation of it (two goats, scapegoat, annual repetition, high priest's own sin offering) — reading Hebrews first would guarantee finding exactly what Hebrews said was there.
